Dutch: Politeness: alstublieft, dank je, sorry

  • Alstublieft = Please / Here you go
  • Dank je wel = Thank you very much
  • Het spijt me = I am sorry
  • Pardon, mag ik erlangs? = Excuse me, can I get past?
  • Geen dank = You're welcome
  • Fijne dag verder! = Have a nice day!

Dutch: Numbers 0-20 and prices

  • Hoeveel kost dit? = How much does this cost?
  • Het kost twaalf euro. = It costs twelve euros.
  • Ik heb drie appels. = I have three apples.
  • Dat is vijftien euro, alstublieft. = That is fifteen euros, please.
  • Heeft u wisselgeld? = Do you have change?
  • Het is helemaal gratis. = It is completely free.
